notices.title: UPDATE: Fort White Dissolution Finds No Support — Ordinance Reading Still on Monday Agenda
notices.description: At a packed special meeting on Tuesday, February 17, Fort White council members and residents found no support for dissolving the town into Columbia County. Both the public and all four council members voiced opposition. Mayor George Thomas echoed residents' sentiments against dissolution. However, a first reading of an ordinance to dissolve the town remains on the agenda for the next regular council meeting on Monday, February 23 — though its future is uncertain following the discussions.

notices.title: State of Emergency — Drought & Cold Weather (Executive Order 26-33)
notices.description: Gov. DeSantis signed Executive Order 26-33 declaring a state of emergency due to worsening drought and agricultural damage from recent cold weather. The order waives agricultural weight restrictions, provides emergency support for farmers, and directs the state to seek federal aid. All north-central Florida counties are now under extreme drought conditions per the latest U.S. Drought Monitor. Gainesville has received just 25% of normal rainfall since January; Ocala only 18%.

notices.title: County-Wide Burn Ban in Effect — Air Tankers Staged in Lake City
notices.displayDate: Effective February 5 — Under Review Every 10 Days
notices.description: Columbia County commissioners approved a temporary county-wide burn ban at the request of the Florida Forest Service. All open burning is prohibited including campfires, yard waste, and trash burning. The Florida Forest Service has moved large air tankers to Lake City to support wildfire response across North Florida. More than 30 counties statewide are under burn bans. Report wildfires immediately to 911.

notices.title: Board of County Commissioners — Regular Meeting
notices.location: School Board Administrative Complex Auditorium, 372 W Duval St, Lake City
notices.description: Regular meeting of the Columbia County Board of Commissioners. Burn ban review, drought response, and Fort White dissolution update may be on the agenda.

notices.title: Water Shortage Advisory — Suwannee River Water Management District
notices.description: The Suwannee River Water Management District has declared a Phase I Moderate Water Shortage. Through December 2025, 14 of 15 SRWMD counties reported an average rainfall deficit of nearly 11.5 inches. All north-central Florida counties are now at extreme drought levels. Residents are urged to conserve water and limit irrigation.
